title: qhull
description: Tool to compute convex hulls and related structures.

input_coords.description: Dimension, number of points, and point coordinates provided via stdin.
input_coords.title: Input Coordinates

delaunay.description: Compute Delaunay triangulation by lifting points to a paraboloid.
delaunay.title: Delaunay Triangulation

furthest_delaunay.description: Compute furthest-site Delaunay triangulation (upper convex hull).
furthest_delaunay.title: Furthest-site Delaunay Triangulation

voronoi.description: Compute Voronoi diagram as the dual of the Delaunay triangulation.
voronoi.title: Voronoi Diagram

halfspace_intersection.description: Compute halfspace intersection about [1,1,0,...] via polar duality.
halfspace_intersection.title: Halfspace Intersection

joggled_input.description: Joggled input instead of merged facets.
joggled_input.title: Joggled Input

verify.description: Verify result: structure, convexity, and point inclusion.
verify.title: Verify Result

vertex_coordinates.description: Vertex coordinates (if 'Qc', includes coplanar points). If 'v', Voronoi vertices.
vertex_coordinates.title: Vertex Coordinates

print_facets.description: Print facets that include point n, -n if not.
print_facets.title: Print Facets
